**Drinfeld twist for quantum su(2) in the adjoint representation**

*Chryssomalis Chryssomalakos*

11 pp, 7 sections.

**Abstract.** We give a detailed description of the adjoint representation of Drinfeld’s twist element, as well as of its coproduct, for suq(2). We also discuss, as applications, the computation of the universal R-matrix in this representation and the problem of symmetrization of identical-particle states with quantum su(2) symmetry. ∗e-mail address: chryss@stp.dias.ie

**Outline.** Front matter; 10 Burlington Road; Abstract; Introduction; Preliminaries; References; Appendix
